description: This Java source file defines the class MessageWithHeader, which is a network protocol message wrapper used in Apache Spark. It holds a header and a body, supporting transfer and reference counting functionalities.

classes.name: MessageWithHeader
classes.description: A network message class that encapsulates a header and a body, supporting transfer, reference counting, and deallocation.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total size of the message (header + body).

methods.name: position
methods.description: Returns the current position, always 0 in this implementation.

methods.name: transferred
methods.description: Returns the total number of bytes transferred so far.

methods.name: transferTo
methods.description: Transfers data to a WritableByteChannel, handling partial transfers and supporting both ByteBuf and FileRegion bodies.

methods.name: deallocate
methods.description: Releases resources associated with header, body, and managedBuffer.

methods.name: copyByteBuf
methods.description: Copies data from ByteBuf to WritableByteChannel, respecting a buffer size limit.

methods.name: touch
methods.description: Updates the reference tracking for this message.

methods.name: retain
methods.description: Increments reference counts for header, body, and managedBuffer.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Decrements reference counts for header, body, and managedBuffer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the message with header and body lengths.
